'''Kaat'o Leeachos''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:Enforcer_LoNH.png|thumb|left|220px|Leeachos apprehending a Nimbanel quarry]]
Kaat'o Leeachos was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was born during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Leeachos began his career the service of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Morbiss]] as a security guard. He later accompanied Morbiss on a trip to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], so that the Hutt could bet on the world's [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]]. However, while Leeachos was dealing with a disobedient slave on the edge of Morbiss' [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], a rival of the Hutt detonated a bomb, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Morbiss and causing Leeachos to lose his right [[Limb/Legends|leg]], as well as suffering severe burns to his right arm. When a team of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Medic/Legends|medics]] arrived on the scene, Leeachos used a hidden cache of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to bribe them into replacing his leg with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacement.

Free from servitude to the Hutts, Leeachos worked as a hired guard on Malastare for a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] until earning enough credits to gain passage off of the world. From there he ventured to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the only world to which he could afford to travel, where he entered the employ of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Knoke]], who trained him in the art of claiming [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. After Knoke perished while attempting to claim a contract for the capture of a rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the midst of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Leeachos successfully fulfilled the contract in the wake of his master's death and went on the forge a reputation for himself as a successful bounty hunter.

[[File:Kaato_Leeachos_Z-95_Headhunter_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Leeachos' personal Z-95 Headhunter, the ''Blade's Edge'']]
At some point in his career, Leeachos purchased a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] for himself, which he named the ''[[Blade's Edge]]''.

Leeachos later betrayed the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a powerful underworld syndicate, who subsequently dispatched a group of agents to apprehend the Nikto. The agents subsequently tracked down and defeated Leeachos in the depths of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld cityscape]] of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="UABS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref>
